# Lobster Haven

> Seafood Restaurant in Tampa, Florida. Lobster rolls piled with claw meat, twin lobsters with corn and potatoes, and steamed baskets with the clams served in broth. A New England shanty on Hillsborough Ave.

- Phone: (813) 855-2888
- Address: 12807 W Hillsborough Ave, Tampa, FL 33635
- Areas: Tampa, Town 'n' Country, Carrollwood, Temple Terrace, Gibsonton
- Offers: Lobster rolls and dinners; Steamed baskets; Fried seafood
- Rating: 4.3 from 1031 Google reviews
